scope: Model 2 (code/model.py::P4MOrientationNet) ONLY. Model 3 not loaded, not evaluated, not modified.

checkpoint.produced_by: code_v2/stage9_train_baselines.py::main() (single training run, saved immediately after training, before held-out evaluation)
checkpoint.note: The only checkpoint file in results_v2/baselines/model2/ -- unambiguous identity, no selection among candidates was required.

reused_verbatim_from_stage9.observed_statistic: obs_S = mean over ALL spatial locations and ALL patches of hypot(q1, q2), where (q1,q2) = posthoc_q_dense(orientation_features, thetas) using the ORIGINAL (unpermuted) channel order. This is a GLOBAL unmasked mean -- NOT the masked per-patch (S,phi) reduction used elsewhere in Stage 9/11's geometric_metrics. This distinction is preserved exactly as implemented, not changed for consistency with other metrics.
reused_verbatim_from_stage9.permutation_mechanism: code_v2/model2_posthoc_q.py::permute_channel_angle_mapping -- permutes the 8-channel axis of the raw orientation_features tensor (leaving thetas = model.orientation_angles() fixed), which is mathematically equivalent to reassigning channel k -> theta_{pi(k)} for a random permutation pi of range(8).

angle_assignment_source: model.orientation_angles() (code/model.py, P4MOrientationNet) -- the model's ACTUAL p4m/D4 (N=4, order 8) angle assignment: rot_idx * (2*pi/4) for rot_idx in {0,1,2,3}, each of the 4 distinct angles appearing at 2 channels (flip and no-flip). This is the exact, already-established implementation, used verbatim rather than the master prompt's simplified theta_k = 2*pi*k/8 description.

resolutions_of_underspecified_details.item: Empirical permutation p-value (not computed by Stage 9's model2_permutation_null, which reports only z-score)
resolutions_of_underspecified_details.resolution: p = fraction of the 100 null_S draws that are <= the observed statistic (one-sided, in the direction actually observed since z < 0 in Stage 9's prior result: (null_S <= obs_S).mean()). This exact directional convention (null <= observed) is the SAME formula already used elsewhere in this codebase for a one-sided permutation p-value (code_v2/stage9_train_baselines.py::geometric_metrics, p_perm_DQ = (null_mean_DQ <= D_Q.mean()).mean()), reused for consistency rather than invented. A two-sided p-value is also reported as a labeled secondary diagnostic.

explicit_scope_limits: This stage does not retrain, fine-tune, or modify Model 2 in any way.
This stage does not alter Stage 11's HOLD status or Stage 12's HOLD status.
This stage is not a Model 2 vs Model 3 comparison and computes no ranking or overall score.
A negative z-score is reported descriptively (observed statistic below the null mean); no mechanistic, biological, or 'anti-nematic' interpretation is attached to the sign.
